title: Professionally designed website credibility and navigation
statement:
A professionally designed, logically arranged, easy-to-navigate website supports credibility, while slow loading and difficult navigation can damage it, so landing pages can choose between richer presentation and a simpler interface without sacrificing usability. (Simson)

Options:
- Simple page structure: clear-sectioned-single-column-layout (fits: minimal, calm, high clarity)
- Persistent navigation: persistent-primary-navigation (fits: information rich, exploratory, large catalog)
- Visible search: prominent-site-search (fits: catalog heavy, utility first, repeat users)
- Lightweight hero: fast-loading-static-hero (fits: performance first, mobile first, conversion focused)
- Polished visual system: visual-brand-system (fits: premium, editorial, brand led)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, corporate websites, online services. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: What makes Web sites credible?: a report on a large quantitative study
source.authors: B. J. Fogg; Jonathan Marshall; Othman Laraki; Alex Osipovich; Chris Varma; Nicholas Fang; Jyoti Paul; Akshay Rangnekar; John Shon; Preeti Swani; Marissa Treinen
source.venue: Proceedings of the SIGCHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI 2001), ACM
